---
title: "Browse manifestos"
subtitle: "Every scored manifesto; open one to see the scores of each model and the evidence"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("_data.R")
library(reactable); library(htmltools)
man <- load_manifestos()
sc  <- load_scores("poplib_v4")
dims <- block_dims("poplib_v4")
show <- c("populism_overall", "pop_ideology_direction", "liberalism_overall",
          "lib_political", "lib_social", "lib_economic", "lib_financial_market")
wide <- sc |> filter(model == "combined", dim %in% show) |> select(doc_id, dim, score) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = dim, values_from = score)
tab <- man |> left_join(wide, by = "doc_id") |>
  transmute(party_link = sprintf('<a href="party/%s.html">%s</a>', party, htmlEscape(coalesce(partyabbrev, str_trunc(partyname, 20)))),
            country_link = sprintf('<a href="country/%s.html">%s</a>', URLencode(countryname, reserved = TRUE), countryname),
            countryname, partyname, parfam, year,
            doc_link = sprintf('<a href="manifesto/%s.html">%s</a>', doc_id, doc_id),
            across(all_of(show)))
```

The scores are the cross-model values used in the paper (Rode & Stöckl 2026). Filter with the
boxes under the column names; click a manifesto id for the scores of each model and the evidence
quotes, a party for its scores over time, a country for its party system.

```{r table, echo=FALSE}
col_score <- function(id) {
  d <- dims[dims$id == id, ]
  colDef(name = d$label, align = "center", minWidth = 95, filterable = FALSE,
         style = function(value) {
           if (is.na(value)) return(list(color = "#bbb"))
           bg <- switch(score_band(value, d$min, d$max), low = "#d6e4f0", mid = "#faf4d4", high = "#f0c7c7", "#eee")
           list(background = bg, color = "#222", fontWeight = 600)
         },
         cell = function(value) if (is.na(value)) "–" else formatC(value, format = "f", digits = if (d$max - d$min <= 2) 2 else 1))
}
cols <- c(list(
  party_link   = colDef(name = "Party", html = TRUE, minWidth = 90),
  country_link = colDef(name = "Country", html = TRUE, minWidth = 120, filterable = FALSE),
  countryname  = colDef(name = "Country (filter)", minWidth = 110),
  partyname    = colDef(name = "Party name", minWidth = 220),
  parfam       = colDef(name = "Family", minWidth = 110),
  year         = colDef(name = "Year", align = "center", maxWidth = 75),
  doc_link     = colDef(name = "Manifesto", html = TRUE, minWidth = 120)),
  setNames(map(show, col_score), show))
reactable(tab, columns = cols, filterable = TRUE, searchable = TRUE, defaultPageSize = 25,
          showPageSizeOptions = TRUE, pageSizeOptions = c(25, 50, 100, 250), highlight = TRUE,
          defaultSorted = list(year = "desc"), striped = TRUE, compact = TRUE)
```
